draft.body:
Siloed credit accounts force you to split your book. wstETH in one pool, stables in another.

Vanna unifies your margin. The borrow guard holds (C+B)/(D+B) >= 1.1 across your entire portfolio, unlocking up to 10x credit capacity on testnet.
